source: Binance Vision public historical daily spot candles, USDT-quoted, not GBP
method: Regularized logistic regression; past 1/3/7/14-day log returns
validation: Chronological 70/30 time split with 2-day embargo; one held-out period; no synthetic samples
warning: Research only. USDT prices are not GBP prices. A single holdout cannot establish predictive skill or profitable trading.

walkForward.method: Four expanding-window chronological folds, 2-day embargo, training-only scaling and L2 logistic regression
walkForward.caution: Exploratory comparison, not untouched final validation. No demonstrated profitability.

regimes.method: Fixed illustrative regimes: 14-day log momentum ±8%; trailing 7-day daily-return volatility 5.5%; volatility takes precedence.
regimes.note: Descriptive research, not learned regime classification or a validated trading signal.

agentCouncil.description: Five fixed-rule specialists; disagreement and risk gates default to no trade.
agentCouncil.limitations: Not trained, not validated as profitable, and does not place orders.

selectiveForecasting.rule: Illustrative fixed filter: forecast only if absolute previous-day log return >=3%; fixed momentum probability 55/45.
selectiveForecasting.warning: Abstention is not evidence of superior predictions; scores on selected examples cannot be directly compared with full-coverage scores.

researchVersion: V28: experimental multi-agent council, validated history, fail-closed evaluation
limitations: Market-regime thresholds are hand-chosen, not learned or independently validated.
Model candidates have been inspected on the same historical data; no untouched final evaluation exists.
Daily candles cannot model intraday execution, spreads, fees, funding, or market impact.
No real-money execution or automated live trading.
